description: A newly authored secondary phrase benchmark created for Testing Build 5. Exact text is excluded from training. This is a development set—not a blind independent scientific study and not a general-intelligence test. It must not be used as training data. Do not tune this release on these rows; replace it for future development if its phrases have been inspected. Four phrases per each of the 26 intent labels, including English, Hindi, Kannada and out-of-domain phrases.
